cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll clear up the concert tonight. You explain the train, then we'll talk about what that empty seat did to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was cancelled. I couldn't get there, and I don't want another trial about it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No trial. We'll put the train aside. Tell me what you think it was like to keep looking for you; take your time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down. I watched the recording, but I can't find better words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we can use the recording. Pick the moment you noticed me looking at the door; we'll start there. You don't need a better word. I need to know you saw how long I kept expecting you.

reason: Replace status prefixes with a directed conversation that gives up prosecuting facts and demanding eloquence, using B recording to secure emotional acknowledgment.
